answer: AWS segment operating income rose to about $39.8 billion in 2024 from about $24.6 billion in 2023. Amazon's filing attributes the increase mainly to higher sales, with AWS net sales up about 19% to roughly $107.6 billion, and to efficiency gains in its cost structure. Partly offsetting that were higher costs for technology infrastructure, including depreciation and power, and for payroll. I also recall that a change in the estimated useful life of a subset of servers, from five to six years effective in 2024, lowered depreciation and added to operating income. I'm less sure of the exact size of that benefit and how the filing words it, so check the 10-K's segment results and accounting estimates sections for the precise figures.
